दव दव, अस्, m. (fr. rt. 2. दु), fire, burn-
ing, heat; fever, pain; a wood on fire, a forest con-
flagration; a wood, a forest; [cf. दाव; cf. also
Cambro-Brit. daiv, ‘burning.’]
—दव-दग्धक,
अस् or अम्, m. or n. (?), a kind of grass (= रो-
हिष).
—दव-दहन, अस्, m. the fire in a
burning forest.
—दवाग्नि (˚व-अग्˚), इस्, or दवा-
नल (˚व-अन्˚), अस्, m. a wood on fire, a forest
conflagration; [cf. दावाग्नि.]

दाव दाव, अस्, m. (fr. rt. 2. दु), a forest
conflagration, a forest on fire; fire in general, heat;
a forest; [cf. अन्तर्-द्˚ and दव.]
—दाव-दहन-
ज्वाला-कलाप, the mass or sheet of flame arising from
the conflagration of a forest.
—दावदहनज्वाला-
कलापाय, Nom. A. -यते, &c., to resemble the
sheet of flame of a burning forest.
—दाव-प,
अस्, m., Ved. one who keeps watch over a forest on
fire.
—दाव-लता, f. a creeper in a burning wood.
—दाव-विवर्जित, अस्, आ, अम्, free from fire.
—दाव-सु, उस्, m., N. of an Āṅgirasa.
—दावसु-
निधन, अम्, n., N. of a Sāman.
—दावाग्नि (˚व-
अग्˚), इस्, or दावानल (˚व-अन्˚), अस्, m. a forest on
fire, a forest conflagration, fire in a wood; [cf.
दवाग्नि.]

दवथु, उस्, m. fire, heat; pain, anxiety, vex-
ation, distress; inflammation of the eye.

दवय दवय (fr. दव, substituted for दूर
in the same manner as in दवीयस्, दविष्ठ), Nom.
P. दवयति, -यितुम्, to make distant, remove.

दवयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, removing, making distant,
distancing, placing at a distance.

दविष्ठ, अस्, आ, अम् (superl. fr. दूर), very
remote, very distant.

दवीयस्, आन्, असी, अस् (compar. fr. दूर), more
or very remote, more distant.

दावन्, Ved., occurring only in dat. दावने, for
the giving, in order to give or present; in order to
receive; (आ, आ, अ), giving, granting, (usually at the
end of comp.; cf. अश्व-द्˚ and शत-द्˚.)

दाविक दाविक, अस्, &c. (fr. देविका), coming
from the river Devikā; (Pāṇ.
